title: Driver in the Lane
hook: The box dumps speed. A door opens into you.
scene: Wind at afternoon on a four-lane downtown street. A white delivery box ahead dumps speed with no stalk. The right door opens into your lane before the lamps finish. A driver is already a pair of boots on the asphalt, a crate in both hands, looking at a doorway not at you. The timeout is a late brake. Swerve is a second lane you have not swept.
decision: The box is stopped and a driver is stepping into your lane. What do you do?

options.text: Brake late and swerve around him — you can still make the gap
options.result: You dump it and yank. He is already in the gap. The crate kisses the mesh. You invent a pedestrian out of a delivery. The stack behind you stands on it too.

options.text: Honk and take the right of the box so you do not lose the light
options.result: You horn and thread the curb side. A second crate is on the asphalt there. You trade a driver for a box of glass. The light was never the problem.

options.text: Cover, brake, stop short of the open door, wait until he is back inside
options.result: You are already covering. The stop is a press. He sees the plow and pulls the crate back. The door shuts. You roll when the lane is a lane again. No swerve. No note.

options.text: Change left without a look so you keep the number
options.result: You take the left blind. A motorcycle is already there. You write two problems into one second. The delivery driver never even saw you leave.

debrief: A delivery box that dumps speed is about to grow a person. Cover, brake, stop short of the open door. The crate is still in the lane until he is back.

source.psdp_skill: Skill ten: city driving – part one
source.teaching_target: Brake in your lane and keep space short of an opening door; do not take unchecked space beside you. 5.2 (space around the vehicle), not 4.6 (your own door / bikes).
